instanceVariables.desc:
[color=#eb8b0c][outlineBack=#000000][lineThickness=2]Ironwood Tower[/color]
A simple defensive tower that rains low-damaging arrows upon your party.

[color=#eb8b0c][outlineBack=#000000][lineThickness=2]Bloodfire Spire[/color]
A dark stone tower crowned by a blood-red crystal. It hurls fireballs that deal low damage on impact and ignite their target, causing additional damage over time.

[color=#eb8b0c][outlineBack=#000000][lineThickness=2]Frostlight Spire[/color]
An ancient-looking tower of smooth white stone, traced with mysterious blue light. Its crystal launches freezing projectiles that deal moderate damage and slow their target on impact.

[color=#eb8b0c][outlineBack=#000000][lineThickness=2]Viper Tower[/color]
A stone tower wrapped in a gigantic venomous serpent. Its projectiles burst on impact, damaging everyone nearby and poisoning them for additional damage over time.

[color=#eb8b0c][outlineBack=#000000][lineThickness=2]Hex Tower[/color]
A wicked tower belonging to a powerful witch. It fires cursed projectiles that deal moderate damage and afflict their target with a curse. Cursed characters suffer increased damage from further cursed attacks.

[color=#eb8b0c][outlineBack=#000000][lineThickness=2]Sunblade Tower[/color]
A massive enchanted sword that floats above a sandstone base. It launches blades of concentrated light that explode on impact, dealing high damage to everyone nearby.
